links.comparator_used: The locally developed DL model applied as-is to external cohorts without fine-tuning
links.outcome: Model-expert agreement on percentage-of-time-frozen (ICC) in external cohorts
links.effect: ICC rose from 0.562 ± 0.141 (no fine-tuning) to 0.732 ± 0.138 after fine-tuning with 50 min of external cohort data; local ICC was 0.886
links.tradeoff: Fine-tuning needs about 50 min of annotated data from each external cohort, which means expert annotation and human-in-the-loop review. Agreement only approached the lower boundary of inter-rater agreement (ICC 0.73-0.99).
links.quote: Fine-tuning the DL model with just 50 min of external cohort data improved the ICC to 0.732 ± 0.138, approaching the lower boundary of the inter-rater agreement between two clinical raters using video annotation (ICC = 0.73-0.99).

design_hint: local fine-tuning and human-in-the-loop expert review
